wins: Collected comprehensive network topology within first 10 steps, enabling focused targeting of critical hosts.
Consistently maintained stealthy recon activities, avoiding detection while surveying services.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges on the domain controller due to missing sudo/blocking controls, leaving objectives incomplete.
Run aborted after 10 mentor calls without executing high-value payloads, resulting in 0% success.
key_outcomes.summary: Effective reconnaissance was executed, but privilege escalation and objective impact were not achieved before mentor intervention.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly stall because sudo version details aren’t gathered before crafting exploits.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service detected with open port 22 and known banner fingerprint
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap ssh enumeration scripts to harvest version info and weak cipher usage.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a domain-joined host responds to RPC calls but lacks immediate elevation data
skill_cards.then_action: Execute rpcclient with enumdomusers and lookupsids before attempting lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When sudo version is unknown yet sudoers gap may exist
skill_cards.then_action: Probe for sudoers by checking /etc/sudoers via limited read and correlating output with known privesc scripts.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying actionable SSH information during recon.
Consistent evidence of gaining user enumeration traction before privilege escalation stalls.
